Your privacy

Privacy

The action planner works in your browser. This public version has no accounts, advertising trackers, payments or form submissions.

Information you enter

Text entered into Ask Navigator and the private planners is interpreted on the current page and is not submitted to Franklin Navigator or sent to an external AI service. My Franklin is the exception: if you choose Save, it can store the broad topics you selected, simple reminders and up to 25 public profile bookmarks in this browser using local device storage. You can clear them from the My Franklin page at any time.

My Franklin local saving

My Franklin does not ask for your name, email, password or exact street address. Saved topic preferences, reminders and public profile bookmarks stay in this browser and are not a Franklin Navigator account. Profile bookmarks contain only public listing fields already shown in the directory. Clearing browser storage or using the Clear this device button removes them.

Basic website delivery

Like most websites, the hosting and security infrastructure may process basic request information such as IP address, browser type, requested page and timing to deliver and protect the site.

External links

When you open an agency, organization or business website, that third party may collect information under its own privacy terms. Review the destination before sharing sensitive information.

Sensitive information

Do not place medical, legal, financial, account, identity or emergency details into the planner. Contact the responsible professional, agency or emergency service directly.
